title: Upgrade Next.js to version 15 and React to version 19
description: Update core framework dependencies to their latest versions and ensure clean installation
details: Update package.json to use Next.js 15 and React 19. Delete node_modules and lock files, then perform clean installation. Clear Next.js cache (.next directory) to ensure clean build environment. Address any immediate compilation errors that arise from the upgrade.
test_strategy: Verify successful installation by running 'npm run dev' and checking that the development server starts without errors. Confirm versions are correctly updated by checking package.json and running 'next --version'.

title: Fix font configuration error in app/layout.tsx
description: Resolve the 'parkinsans' fallback font error by correcting the font import and configuration
details: Investigate the font import in app/layout.tsx from 'next/font'. Correct the likely typo 'parkinsans' to the intended font name (possibly 'Parkinsans' or another valid font). Ensure proper fallback font configuration according to Next.js 15 font API. Update the font variable and CSS class usage if needed.
test_strategy: Check browser console for font-related errors. Verify that text renders correctly across all pages. Test font loading in both development and production builds.

title: Verify third-party dependency compatibility
description: Check and update third-party packages for React 19 and Next.js 15 compatibility
details: Review all dependencies in package.json for React 19 compatibility, especially UI libraries like Radix UI primitives, authentication libraries, and any other React-dependent packages. Update incompatible packages to compatible versions or implement temporary workarounds. Pay special attention to shadcn/ui components and any custom UI library integrations.
test_strategy: Run 'npm run build' to check for build-time compatibility issues. Test all UI components in the components/ui directory for proper rendering and functionality. Check for any peer dependency warnings during installation.

title: Perform comprehensive regression testing
description: Conduct full application testing to ensure all functionality works correctly after the upgrade
details: Test all critical user flows including: navigation between pages, sign-in and sign-up authentication flows, dashboard functionality, form submissions, and UI component rendering. Verify that all pages load correctly and check browser console for any new errors or warnings. Test responsive design and ensure visual consistency across different screen sizes.
test_strategy: Manual testing of all routes and user flows. Run existing test suite if available. Test in multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari). Verify production build works correctly with 'npm run build' and 'npm start'. Check for any performance regressions or visual inconsistencies.
